title: Baby Buddy child Dashboard
presentation: Complete source-template page with deterministic synthetic fixture; not original screenshot or live app

original_screenshot.personal_data_provenance: Not independently established; no identity or numeric values copied

changes: All child, user, time, feeding, sleep, diaper and tummy-time values replaced with new deterministic synthetic fixture.
Original Django template hierarchy, nine cards, order, Bootstrap layout classes, source theme and Font Awesome icon mapping preserved.
Original source SCSS compiled with libsass 0.23.0 rather than historical gulp/node-sass; unrelated report styles omitted.
Data query tags replaced with fixture-only rendering; no historical app/database/server executed.
Only original dropdown and navbar collapse interactions retained using lock-pinned original JS libraries.
Cross-page links replaced with non-navigating #preview-only anchors and aria-disabled/title; no substitute pages/modal designs added.
Unneeded favicon/manifest, vendor date-picker CSS and original data-refresh JS removed.
Nonvisual main landmark and progressbar values added.
limits: No browser executed: desktop/mobile visual fidelity, font loading, menu/collapse behavior, keyboard and screen-reader behavior pending single-owner review.
Original screenshot displays Dashboard, not core/templates/core/child_detail.html. The latter is a different name/birth-date/age/actions page.
Not byte-identical to original screenshot; fixture data intentionally differ and modern Django/LibSass rendering may have minor formatting differences.
Historical dependencies are retained only for this isolated reference; not suitable as production dependency recommendations.
No real family data, photos, backend/model calls, persistence, authentication, source repository writes or deployment.
